Nice to meet you, I'm Vtuber Tamaki Inuyama. I saw your wonderful illustrations and reached out because I'd very much like to commission you. ■ Illustration Content I'd like you to draw an illustration of Vtuber "Tamaki Inuyama". I have many outfits, but I'd be thrilled if you could draw me in whichever outfit you like best. My gender is male, and I'm a "moe-style" character, so I'd appreciate it if you could just be mindful of the chest depiction...!
(Since the appearance leans female, there's no need to force a masculine depiction...!) Official Website Character Introduction https://noripro.jp/talent-inuyama/ ■Desired Delivery Format I would be delighted if you could provide a PSD file with the character and background on separate layers.

■Purpose: We plan to use it for YouTube thumbnails and promotional activities on Twitter. When using it, we will credit your Twitter account in the YouTube description or within the Twitter tweet text. ■Composition and Requests: Since it will be used for YouTube thumbnails, a composition that clearly shows the face would be ideal. We would greatly appreciate it if you could draw the character so that the top of the head and hair are not cut off at the edges. Thank you very much for your consideration!

Dear Tanuki-sama, Nice to meet you! I'm Yuyuyu🎀 I saw your illustration before and fell in love at first sight with the adorable faces and color palette, so I'm requesting you to draw my character...!

Here's the reference material↓ https://x.com/yuyuyuchan1130/status/2030873178466320713?s=46&t=4vyu7nL66fR8alY_ZLVIxw As additional details, she has purple inner hair color, and her eyes have a gradient from blue → purple → yellow from top to bottom.

There are two outfits: a maid costume and a regular outfit. I'll leave it up to you, Tanuki-sama, to decide which one to use! Regarding the composition, as long as it's cute, feel free to draw it however you like! I know you're busy, but I'd really appreciate it if you could consider this! 🙇🏻‍♀️

Hello! This is 💍 (Diamond Ring) who requested an illustration before! The art you drew for me last time and the time before that was absolutely wonderful—I have it displayed in my room 🥰 This time, I'm sending a request for a different character!

This time, the character I'd like you to draw is one I created myself! I'd appreciate it if you could refer to the character design in the link below. It doesn't matter which one you choose—please draw whichever one catches your eye. I'll leave the pose and outfit up to you, and please give them a mischievous smile.

I plan to use the artwork as my SNS icon and header, and also to create personal goods like acrylic keychains and stands. (Regarding the goods, I will not sell or distribute them; they will be solely for my personal use.) Also, the white-haired character (not the mermaid) is a character I use for my game streams, so I may also use it for thumbnails and videos. Please keep that in mind as well.

If possible, I'd also appreciate receiving a version with the character separated from the background. (Feel free to skip this if it's too difficult.) I know you're busy, but I truly appreciate your help. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AH99hUkb1OTYkuQSw4VbmOp9BJgjZW5t

Dear Tanuki-sama, Nice to meet you! I'm Seto Warabi, a video creator V! I'd like to request that you draw my own V in your style, Tanuki-sama. 🙇‍♀️ I have no specific requests or restrictions, so I'd like to leave it entirely up to you!

【Character Details】 I'm emotionally expressive with a slightly dark aura! I adore cute things (especially polar bears), eating, and singing! Feel free to modify my clothing or other details! (The nose band-aid is a must!) I'd be thrilled if you could draw me however you like! ◎ 【Data Requirements】 It would be incredibly helpful if you could provide a layered PSD file! 【Intended Uses】
・SNS icons, headers, etc. ・Thumbnails and video-related content for activities (May also be used for short videos or cover song videos.) ・Personal merchandise That's all! I'd be grateful if you could consider this. https://drive.google.com/drive/mobile/folders/1Y25lp80-T3pAhD8rjw7nlYGsNAE484uQ

Hello Tananuki-sama, my name is Ruby Yumemi, and I am a personal VTuber.
I fell in love at first sight with the illustration of Hatsune Miku drawn by Tananuki-sama, and I thought, "I would love to have you draw me too! I would love to have you draw me too!
Here are the details of the request.
I would appreciate it if you could check the details.

◾️ Character
Personal VTuber "Ruby Yumemi" (Reference image: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15kD7y4Z7ePr7HSGm3M8eht9Ld9_7TNzt?usp=drive_link )
-Character Outline: Succubus young lady who wandered into the Internet through a dream
-Hair color: Ruby (between red and pink)
-Eyes: Dark pink
-Black to ruby gradient wings, horn, and tail
-Bright and energetic, but also has a devilish element to her personality.

◾️ illustration details
-The composition of the illustration is up to the waist, and the pose is up to the artist.
The pose can be left up to the artist. (Please refer to the "Other Costume Settings" file in the document.)
-If it is possible within the price, we would appreciate it if you could also provide facial expression differences.
-We would appreciate it if you could provide us with facial expression differences as well, if possible, for a fee. If possible, we would greatly appreciate it if you could make sure that the head, hair, wings, horns, etc. of the person are not visible.

◾️ Usage
Thumbnails, video clips, and in-stream materials for YouTube and other video distribution sites
-Announcements, headers, and icons on social networking sites, etc.
⸻Please contact us for more information.

We would be happy to have the opportunity to work with you.
We look forward to working with you.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15kD7y4Z7ePr7HSGm3M8eht9Ld9_7TNzt?usp=drive_link

I would love to have you draw me an illustration!

Clothing: As long as it is not too revealing, it does not have to be a maid's uniform. Private clothes or loungewear are also acceptable.

Background: Any

Usage: I would like to use it for YouTube thumbnails, Twitter icons, tweets, etc.

I will send you Twitter and a standing picture for reference.

Thank you very much for your consideration.

tanuki (Nyctereutes procyonoides)

It is nice to meet you!
My name is Ruri Sorairo, and I am an individual Vtuber.
I saw your illustration on X, and I thought it was very cute and attractive, so I sent this request to you.

I would love to work with you.
I would be happy if the pose and composition are left to you, and if it is cheerful!
I would like to use the character's eyes as thumbnails, etc!
I would appreciate it if you could draw the character's head, hair ornament, hair, etc. so that I can use them as thumbnails.

Character
The motif of the character is based on the Japanese ghost, Aoandon, which appears as a mysterious entity after telling a hundred ghost stories.
The colors of the image are blue and light blue, with cherry blossoms and butterflies as motifs.
Her hair color is slightly gradated, and the ends are slightly whitish.
Her personality is energetic and she talks a lot.

Usage.
I will use them for Vtuber activities such as SNS, monetized Youtube (thumbnails, delivery, videos, etc.), etc.
If possible, we would also appreciate it if you could give us permission for online printing at convenience stores and production of goods!
(If there is something that is not allowed to be used, please put it on a separate layer from the illustration...!)

Reference materials
https://twitter.com/aoandon_ruri/status/1475848833775312898
https://twitter.com/aoandon_ruri/status/1469985383480012801

File Format
We would like to receive PSD data with separate layers for characters, signatures, backgrounds, etc. If you can write the lanterns next to the characters, it would be appreciated if you can write them on a separate layer.
　If you can also write Andon next to the character, it would be helpful if it is on a separate layer from the character!

Thank you in advance for your consideration!

https://x.com/aoandon_ruri

Hi, I'm a member of the community and I'd like to thank you for your interest! My name is 💍 and I have already made a request once before!
The illustration you drew last time was so beautiful that I look at it every day and smile 🥰.
I would like to send a request for a different character this time!

The character I would like you to draw is my surrogate character!
I would appreciate it if you could refer to the following link for the character design.
The pose is up to you, and the expression should be a smile or a smiling face!
As for the costume, please use the classical one-piece costume (the one with the 3-sided view) in the document. (This one is designed by someone else, but we have permission.)

We would like to use it as an icon or header for social networking sites, or to make personal goods (such as ackee, acsta, etc.). (I will not sell or distribute any of the goods, but only own them myself.)

Also, if possible, I would like to receive separate portraits and backgrounds. (If this is too difficult, please do not send it to me.)

I know you are busy, but thank you in advance...!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vxrvI0thsFhyhyiTumjqV0L9YKp1Gxru

Thank you very much for your support, Sayu Chazakura!
I love Tananuki's illustrations so much that I sent a request to him since I heard that he is going to resume requests!
If you have time, I would appreciate it...!

◾︎ Usage
 For viewing, use as an icon for a sub-sub-plot, display on a distribution screen for future projects, etc.

◾︎Size and composition
 Not specified

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BQQuQ5e4lC437uiWNK__6L_9cck90aT6

We hope to have the opportunity to work with you. ......!

V-Mike-o-chan

0 Purpose of use

Size and delivery format
We would be happy if the illustration is 4K size or landscape and suitable for wallpaper.

z Other

Nice to meet you!
My name is Ankoro Koji, and I am a Vtuber.
I fell in love with your beautiful illustrations from the first time I saw them on Twitter!
I love your eyes and the composition of your illustrations, and I really like your sparkling and cute illustrations.

I really love the eyes and composition of your illustrations.
I would like you to draw an illustration with your favorite composition, expression, and pose!
I'd like you to draw her in your favorite outfit.
I would like to use it as a thumbnail, so I would like it to be an eye-catching illustration!
I would like her to have a cute expression without closing her eyes.

Characteristics of the character
I want a cute girl with a young age.
*Hair color: All hair ends are reddish-pink (bangs ends, princess hair ends, twinning hair ends), hair roots are white, gradation of white from reddish-pink hair ends to the roots. *These are the sticking points! More gray hair.
Hairstyle: Loosely pulled down below the ear in a twin-tail.
Eye color: Yellow with a hint of orange.
Eye color: Yellow with a hint of orange.
Hearts, ribbons, and frills are her motifs.

Usage
Distribution activities (already monetized)
SNS, thumbnails and icons
(Image size that we can use without any problem)
We are also considering using them in other activities and making them into merchandise.

Other
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with separate data or PSD files of the person, background, message, etc.

Thank you very much for your consideration!

Main SNS
https://lit.link/koiroankoro
Please refer to the image below for reference.

Hello, my name is Kuroiwa, and I am the owner of the UTAU character Yuka Satoshiishi. I would like to ask Tananuki-san to do an illustration of Yuka Satoshiishi for me, so I have sent him a sketch. There are three types of Yuka Satoshiishi: before transformation, after transformation, and further transformation. I would like to ask for an illustration of one of them after her transformation (in a sailor suit with pink twin-tails). The hollow in the twin-tail is a feature. The setting of this girl is "I'm afraid of becoming an adult, so I'm redoing the world on my 18th birthday," but I don't mind if you draw it the way Tananuki's brush rides.
